docker.initial_state: Windows Docker CLI daemon was unavailable before Docker Desktop was started hidden; no host-process fallback was used.
docker.final_state: Docker Desktop engine reachable from Windows CLI and WSL Ubuntu.
docker.registry_pull: registry-1.docker.io was unreachable during image preparation; docker build --pull=false was used.

base_substitution.reason: Docker Hub ubuntu:22.04 pull timed out; a pre-existing local Ubuntu 22.04-based NVIDIA CUDA image was aliased to ubuntu:22.04 without modifying the Dockerfile.

container_runtime.seccomp: unconfined for deterministic sanitizer ASLR control

network_policy: Container execution used --network none. Registry access was used only to prepare/build the image, not during candidate/control execution.
limitations: The base image was a locally cached NVIDIA CUDA Ubuntu 22.04 image aliased as ubuntu:22.04 because Docker Hub was unreachable; the resulting validation image is pinned by immutable ID.

Seccomp was set to unconfined to permit setarch -R for deterministic sanitizer ASLR control. Capabilities remained dropped, rootfs read-only, no-new-privileges enabled, and resources/network were constrained.
Generic shared_ptr TSan controls are method evidence only and do not prove any sampled component vulnerable.
